landmarks.name: Boma National Park
landmarks.writeup: One of the largest national parks in Africa, known for its diverse wildlife and seasonal migration of antelopes.

wiki.extract: Boma National Park is a protected area in eastern South Sudan near the Ethiopian border. It was established in 1977 and covers 22,800 km2 (8,800 sq mi) of grasslands and floodplains.

landmarks.name: Nimule National Park
landmarks.writeup: Located near the border with Uganda, it features savannah landscapes and a variety of wildlife including elephants and lions.

wiki.extract: The Nimule National Park is a national park in South Sudan. It was established in 1954, and extends over an area of 410 km2, along the border with Uganda.

landmarks.name: Juba Nile Bridge
landmarks.writeup: A key infrastructure landmark in the capital city, connecting different parts of Juba across the White Nile.

wiki.extract: Juba is the capital and largest city of South Sudan. The city is situated on the White Nile and also serves as the capital of the Central Equatoria State. It is the most recently declared national capital and had a population of 525,953 in 2017. It has an area of 52 km2 (20 sq mi), with the metropolitan area covering 336 km2 (130 sq mi).

cultural_events.name: South Sudan Independence Day
cultural_events.writeup: Celebrated on July 9th, marking the country's independence from Sudan in 2011.

cultural_events.name: Traditional Dance Festivals
cultural_events.writeup: Various ethnic groups celebrate with traditional dances and music, showcasing their cultural heritage.

food_writeup: South Sudanese cuisine features staples like sorghum, millet, and maize, often served with stews made from meat, fish, and vegetables. Popular dishes include kisra (a type of bread) and asida (a porridge).
brief_history: South Sudan gained independence from Sudan in 2011 after decades of civil war. It is the world's youngest country but has faced ongoing internal conflicts and challenges in nation-building.

important_people.name: Riek Machar
important_people.description: Vice President and key political figure

important_people.name: John Garang (deceased)
important_people.description: Leader of the Sudan People's Liberation Army and a pivotal figure in the independence movement

current_conflicts: Internal ethnic and political conflicts persist, including clashes between government forces and opposition groups, impacting stability and humanitarian conditions.
